2116510525437956429.en_summary: Danielle DiMartino Booth says the real driver is token yield: ~13x annual deflation in machine intelligence, pointing to ~8,000x more tokens by 2030. Tension is someone has to pay for it out of $115T global GDP / money supply. Quotes BenBrey on both sides of AI trade wrong, Burry 2008 playbook, Ackman infinite ROI.
2116510525437956429.zh_summary: Danielle DiMartino Booth說真正驅動因素是代幣收益：機器智能約13倍年通縮，指向2030年約8000倍更多代幣。緊張之處是有人必須從115萬億美元全球GDP/貨幣供應中支付。引用BenBrey指AI交易雙方都錯，Burry用2008劇本，Ackman說無限ROI。

2116509823730639331.en_summary: Robin Brooks says early ECB departures allow the Euro elite to lock in their pet candidates ahead of French elections, done in the name of preserving democracy. He would never vote for AfD or Le Pen, but do not pretend this is about preserving democracy.
2116509823730639331.zh_summary: Robin Brooks說歐央行提前離職允許歐元精英在法國選舉前鎖定他們的寵兒候選人，以維護民主的名義進行。他絕不會投票給AfD或勒龐，但不要假裝這是關於維護民主。

2116507824981164100.en_summary: (Reposted by @WarrenPies) Mark Biller says great balanced overview of where things stand after a nerve-wracking end of the week, quoting Warren Pies discussing why they cut risk early this week and what looking for to add exposure back, on tech selloff being technical not fundamental.
2116507824981164100.zh_summary: （由@WarrenPies轉帖）Mark Biller說在令人緊張的週末之後事物現狀的出色平衡概述，引用Warren Pies討論為何他們本週早些時候削減風險以及尋找什麼來重新增加敞口，關於科技股拋售是技術性而非基本面。

2116507185387561305.en_summary: Robin Brooks says one of the biggest structural breaks in recent weeks is that 10-year Treasury yield has fallen as oil prices have risen. That is new and most likely reflects the festering debt crisis in Europe, channeling more safe haven flows into US Treasuries.
2116507185387561305.zh_summary: Robin Brooks說最近幾週最大的結構性突破之一是10年期國債收益率在油價上漲時下跌。這是新的，最可能反映歐洲不斷惡化的債務危機，將更多避險流動導向美國國債。
